tasks.title: Short workplace visits
tasks.instruction:
You must answer this question. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.

In your English class you have been talking about short workplace visits for students. Now your English teacher has asked you to write an essay.

Write an essay using all the notes and giving reasons for your point of view.

Some schools arrange short visits to local workplaces so that students can see what different jobs involve. What are the benefits of these visits, and which is the most valuable outcome?

promptBlocks.heading: Notes
paragraphs: Career awareness – understanding what jobs really involve
Professional communication – seeing how people interact at work

tasks.title: Documentary review
tasks.instruction:
Answer one of these questions. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.

You see this announcement in your college English-language magazine.

promptBlocks.heading: Reviews wanted
paragraphs: A Day in the Life – a new documentary about working people in our region
listItems: How effectively does the film show what working life is really like?
What is the most memorable scene or interview?
Would you recommend this documentary to other students?
promptBlocks.footer: Send us your review and we will publish the best ones in next month's magazine.

tasks.title: Skills employers value
tasks.instruction:
Answer one of these questions. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.

You see this announcement on a careers website for young people.

promptBlocks.heading: Articles wanted
paragraphs: What skills do employers look for?
listItems: Which two skills do you think are most useful in the workplace?
How can young people develop these skills while still at school or college?
promptBlocks.footer: Write an article answering these questions. The best articles will be featured on our site.

tasks.title: Weekend work decision
tasks.instruction:
Answer one of these questions. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.

You have received this email from your English-speaking friend Alex.

promptBlocks.subject: Weekend job offer
paragraphs: I've been offered a weekend job at a local café. It would mean working both Saturday and Sunday, but the pay is good and I'd get experience. I'm not sure if I should take it because I have exams coming up. What do you think?
What are the advantages of doing this job? Is there any risk I should watch out for? And how should I decide?
